verdict.rationale: Vue documents itself as 'incrementally adoptable' and built on standard HTML/CSS/JS, and a community member notes it can easily be added piecemeal to existing templates to improve old apps. Both strongly imply drop-in usage without a build step, but no evidence explicitly describes loading Vue via a script tag or CDN. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of script-tag/CDN usage, confirmation that no package manager or bundler is needed, and hands-on corroboration of a no-build workflow.
